headline.purpose: 聊天首页；手机按 shell.css 缩小。

body.purpose: 500字重，Noto Sans/CJK SC Medium；长文阅读，不作为A2UI覆盖规则。

motion.name: panel
motion.purpose: 手机导航左16px、工作区右20px进入，opacity .6→1。

motion.name: menu-enter
motion.purpose: web/styles.css；既有菜单动效，非 Grok 实测。

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: web/styles.css prefers-reduced-motion:reduce 禁用动画/过渡。

motion.name: navigation
motion.purpose: web/tokens.css + shell.css；桌面256px/57px宽度连续切换。

components.name: 主要按钮
components.description: web/styles.css + web/shell.css；实体反相按钮，危险变体独立语义色。
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,100ms),color var(--motion-fast,100ms),opacity var(--motion-fast,100ms);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:12px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 18px;font-weight:550;background:var(--strong, #1b1a18);color:var(--on-strong, #fff);}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--control-hover, #2b2a27);}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

components.name: 危险确认
components.description: web/styles.css + web/shell.css；实体反相按钮，危险变体独立语义色。
components.css: .ds-destructive{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,100ms),color var(--motion-fast,100ms),opacity var(--motion-fast,100ms);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:12px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 18px;font-weight:550;background:var(--danger-fill, #b42318);color:var(--on-danger, #ffffff);}.ds-destructive:hover:not(:disabled){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger-fill, #b42318),var(--text, #171717) 10%);}.ds-destructive:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-destructive:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-destructive:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

components.name: 圆形图标按钮
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="添加附件"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,100ms),color var(--motion-fast,100ms),opacity var(--motion-fast,100ms);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, #646464);}.ds-icon:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--hover, #eaeae8);color:var(--text, #171717);}.ds-icon:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--surface, #f3f3f2);}.ds-icon:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-icon:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

components.name: 普通字段
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="名称" placeholder="输入名称" />
components.css: .ds-input{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;min-width:0;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line, #e5e5e3);border-radius:9px;background:var(--bg, #ffffff);color:var(--text, #171717);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0b7ce0);outline-offset:2px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

components.name: 导航行
components.description: ConversationNavigation.tsx + shell.css；桌面36px、手机44px的导航按钮。
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="对话导航"><button class="ds-nav-button">新建聊天</button><button class="ds-nav-button">搜索聊天</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;width:232px;color:var(--text, #171717);}.ds-nav-button{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,100ms),color var(--motion-fast,100ms),opacity var(--motion-fast,100ms);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:6px;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:inherit;}.ds-nav-button:hover{background:var(--hover, #eaeae8);}.ds-nav-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

components.name: 目录行
components.description: web/styles.css；轻量列表容器，无独立卡片阴影。
components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;border-radius:12px;padding-right:4px;color:var(--text, #171717);}.ds-card:hover{background:var(--surface, #f3f3f2);}.ds-card-button{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,100ms),color var(--motion-fast,100ms),opacity var(--motion-fast,100ms);display:flex;flex:1;gap:14px;align-items:center;min-width:0;padding:14px 8px;border:0;border-radius:12px;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:inherit;}.ds-card-button strong{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;}.ds-card-button small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted, #646464);}.ds-card-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

components.name: 聊天输入容器
components.description: App.tsx + styles.css + shell.css；预览仅演示视觉，不绑定发送。
components.css: .ds-composer{max-width:752px;min-height:106px;padding:14px 12px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line, #e5e5e3);border-radius:24px;background:var(--surface, #f3f3f2);}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text, #171717) 24%,var(--bg, #ffffff));}.ds-composer:has(textarea:focus-visible){outline:1px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-textarea{display:block;resize:none;width:100%;min-height:34px;max-height:220px;padding:0 8px 6px;border:0;outline:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text, #171717);font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.75;}.ds-textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #646464);opacity:1;}.ds-tools{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:8px;gap:8px;}.ds-send{font-family:"Noto Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,100ms),color var(--motion-fast,100ms),opacity var(--motion-fast,100ms);display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--strong, #1b1a18);color:var(--on-strong, #fff);}.ds-send:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-1px);}.ds-send:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0);}.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #545454);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-send:disabled{opacity:1;cursor:not-allowed;background:var(--line, #e5e5e3);color:var(--muted, #646464);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-destructive,.ds-icon,.ds-nav-button,.ds-card-button,.ds-send{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
以温黑画布、接近白色的正文、克制边线和圆角输入容器建立安静的聊天空间。中性无衬线承担中文阅读与控件信息，工具密度集中于需要操作的区域。浅色沿用相同语义角色，由白与灰区分层级。

保留 newbot 名称与既有能力。视觉参考来自 Grok 可见首页的实际观察；Grok 菜单精确动效、设置内部和付费流程未确认。浅色、设置及工作区属于 newbot 的适配，不宣称逐项复刻。
keyCharacteristics: 温黑与中性浅色共享语义 token。
内容区克制，输入容器与圆形操作形成识别。
导航、设置和工作区按需展开，状态与授权保持可见。
短距离定向进入，并尊重减少动态效果设置。

rules.name: Semantic Theme
rules.body: 以语义变量连接聊天、设置、菜单和预览；主题切换同时替换背景、文字、边线和状态色。

rules.name: Content Before Decoration
rules.body: 标题、正文和控件依靠字号、字重与空间区分，不给聊天正文恢复装饰性宽字距。

rules.name: Flat Resting Surface
rules.body: 聊天画布与列表保持平面；浮层用边线和环境阴影说明覆盖关系。

dos: Do 使用共享语义变量，并同时核对浅深色的文字、背景和焦点。
Do 在手机保持输入、发送、模型和审批可达；长标题省略，保留工具入口。
Do 首页保持标题与输入，移除用户明确不需要的建议和底部提示。
Do 保留加载、错误、禁用和权限反馈，以及键盘焦点和减少动态效果。
donts: Don't 复制 Grok 标志或字体文件，也不把未观察的菜单动效写成参考事实。
Don't 为视觉简洁隐藏真实状态、审批语义或私密输入边界。
Don't 将聊天首页构图强加给所有设置和产物页面。
Don't 将预览色阶当作新增产品 token；实际色值以源码和本文件 frontmatter 为准。
